key_findings: SkillOS has a strong independent reproduction caution: same-executor apparent checkpoint peaks are non-monotone and do not survive multiplicity after contemporaneous-baseline correction, while a cross-executor +13.6pp arm still reproduces the paper-scale benefit.
SPADE reports best checkpoints selected on the same eight-benchmark suite, so its reported gains are selected statistics rather than untouched-final estimates.
SAPO provides a direct pre-storage matched marginal-utility gate: full vs no-validation is +1.6 ALFWorld and +7.5 WebShop score/+3.1 success in the tested configuration.

Blind Curator shows contribution retirement can become mathematically inoperative under systematic false-pass bias; with tau=0.10 the tested cliff is 0.45, while symmetric noise mainly increases sample demand.

SkillBrew directly fills the benign removal-ablation frontier: Add+Rewrite+Remove vs Add+Rewrite is +5.5 ALFWorld, +8.3 WebShop score, +0.8 WebShop success, while Rewrite and Remove are complementary rather than substitutes.
artifact_gap: The SAPO paper links github.com/zzwjames/skill_augmented_agent as code, but the observed public default branch currently contains only a six-byte README and repository size 0; implementation claims therefore remain paper-only in this run.
